app.title: CamLooper - Stay Present, Keep Your Privacy

topbar.tagline: Stay present in class while keeping your privacy — record a short clip, then loop it as your camera.

stage.previewPlaceholder: Your camera preview will appear here

step1.title: Step 1 · Go live
step1.desc: This is exactly what your class will see. Pick your camera and sit how you want to appear.
step1.noCamera: No camera found. Plug in a webcam and reopen CamLooper.
step1.loopExisting: Already have a clip? Loop an existing video instead

step2.title: Step 2 · Record your loop
step2.desc: Record 10–30 seconds of yourself looking natural. A few small movements — a nod, a glance — make the loop believable.

review.title: Looks good?
review.desc: Here's your clip. Loop it as your webcam, or record again.

loop.title: You're covered
loop.covered: Your clip is now looping as your webcam. In <apps>Zoom, Teams or Meet</apps>, choose <device>“CamLooper Virtual Camera”</device> as your camera — then you can step away.
loop.liveOnDesc: Your real camera is on. Turn off to go back to the loop.
loop.liveOffDesc: Pause the loop and show your real camera for a moment.

advanced.resolutionLocked: Turn the camera off to change this.
advanced.naturalMotionDesc: Drift back and forth through the clip instead of replaying it in order, so the loop has no seam and never repeats.
advanced.naturalMotionRestart: Takes effect next time you start the loop.
advanced.naturalMotionTruncated: Clip is too long to buffer — natural motion uses its first {{seconds}}s.

errors.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported video format. Please choose an MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV or AVI file.
errors.uploadFailed: Failed to upload video. Please try again.

vcam.startFailedTitle: Could not start the virtual camera

driver.declinedDesc: Windows needs administrator approval once to install the CamLooper virtual camera. It won’t appear in Zoom, Meet or OBS until you allow it.
driver.failedTitle: Could not install the virtual camera driver
driver.failedDesc: Registration failed. Try reinstalling CamLooper, or run it once as administrator.
driver.registeredDesc: You may need to restart Zoom, Meet or OBS for “DirectShow Softcam” to appear in the camera list.

linux.declinedDesc: CamLooper needs permission once to load its virtual camera driver. It won’t appear in Zoom, Meet or OBS until you allow it.
linux.notInstalledDesc: The v4l2loopback driver isn’t built for your kernel. In a terminal run: sudo apt install linux-headers-$(uname -r) v4l2loopback-dkms && sudo dkms autoinstall — then restart CamLooper.
linux.secureBootTitle: Secure Boot is blocking the driver
linux.secureBootDesc: Secure Boot won’t let the unsigned v4l2loopback module load. Enroll the DKMS key (sudo mokutil --import …) or disable Secure Boot in your BIOS, then restart CamLooper.
linux.noPkexecTitle: Couldn’t load the virtual camera driver
linux.noPkexecDesc: CamLooper couldn’t ask for permission to load the driver. Run this once in a terminal: sudo modprobe v4l2loopback — then start the camera again.
linux.permissionTitle: No access to the camera device
linux.permissionDesc: Add yourself to the “video” group: sudo usermod -aG video $USER — then log out and back in.
linux.failedTitle: Could not enable the virtual camera
linux.failedDesc: Loading the v4l2loopback driver failed. Try running sudo modprobe v4l2loopback in a terminal, or reinstall CamLooper.
linux.loadedDesc: You may need to restart Zoom, Meet or OBS for “CamLooper Virtual Camera” to appear in the camera list.

mac.failedTitle: Could not install the CamLooper camera
mac.failedDesc: macOS refused the camera extension. Make sure CamLooper is in the Applications folder, then reopen it.
mac.approvedDesc: Restart Zoom, Meet or OBS if they were open, so “CamLooper Virtual Camera” appears in their camera list.
mac.gateDesc: macOS needs your approval before CamLooper can appear as a camera in Zoom, Meet and other apps. System Settings has been opened for you.
mac.gateStep1: In System Settings, go to General → Login Items & Extensions.
mac.gateStep2: Under Extensions, click the ⓘ next to Camera Extensions.
mac.gateStep3: Switch on CamLooper and confirm with your password or Touch ID.
mac.gateWaiting: Waiting for your approval — this screen closes by itself.

remote.title: Phone remote
remote.networkNote: CamLooper connects to the internet only after you link a phone.
remote.unlinkedDesc: Link your phone to start a Zoom, Teams or Meet call on this computer from anywhere: CamLooper opens the meeting and switches your loop on.
remote.codeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code shown in CamLooper Remote on your phone

errors.code_invalid: That code didn't work. Codes expire after five minutes — get a new one on your phone.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the CamLooper remote service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute.
errors.disabled: The phone remote isn't available in this build.

remote.linkedDesc: Send a meeting link from your phone and this computer opens it.
remote.autostartDesc: Starts hidden in the tray so your phone can always reach it.
remote.trayHint: While a phone is linked, closing the window keeps CamLooper running in the tray.
remote.toastLinkedDesc: CamLooper will start at login and wait in the tray, ready for meetings sent from your phone.
remote.toastAutostartFailed: Linked, but start at login could not be enabled. You can turn it on under Advanced → Phone remote.
remote.noLoopHintDesc: Record or load a clip so CamLooper can turn your camera on when a meeting arrives.
remote.rejectedTitle: Ignored a link from your phone
remote.rejectedDesc: Only https links to Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet are accepted.
remote.unlinkedByPhoneDesc: This computer is no longer linked to a phone and has stopped connecting to the internet.

autoJoin.label: Join meetings automatically
autoJoin.desc: Opens the meeting in a separate {{browser}} window that CamLooper controls, allows the camera and microphone, and clicks Join for you.
autoJoin.noBrowser: Needs Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge or Brave on this computer.
autoJoin.nameLabel: Your name in meetings (used when you're not signed in)
autoJoin.openBrowserHint: Sign in to Google, Microsoft or Zoom there once so meetings join directly, and pick the CamLooper camera in each service's settings.
autoJoin.admissionDesc: The meeting host has to let you in. Sign in once via “Open meeting browser” so your own meetings join directly.
autoJoin.timeoutDesc: The meeting page is open in the CamLooper browser window; join from there.

remote.streamHint: Stream your phone's camera: open the CamLooper Remote page on your phone and tap Start streaming.

phoneStream.confirmTitle: Use your phone as the camera?
phoneStream.confirmBody: {{phone}} wants to stream its camera to CamLooper. Your current video will be paused while the phone is live.

errors.ice_failed: Couldn't connect directly to the phone. Put the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi, or connect the computer to the phone's hotspot.
errors.ice_failed_windows: Couldn't connect directly to the phone. Put the phone and computer on the same Wi-Fi, or connect the computer to the phone's hotspot. Also make sure Windows Firewall allows CamLooper on private networks.
errors.timeout: The phone stopped sending video. Check that it is still on the CamLooper Remote page, then start streaming again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong with the phone stream. Start streaming again from your phone.

phoneStream.expired: That request has already expired. Tap Start streaming on your phone again.
phoneStream.offline: CamLooper isn't connected to the phone service right now. Try again in a moment.
phoneStream.stopFailed: Couldn't stop the phone camera. Try again, or quit CamLooper.
phoneStream.controlsLocked: Your phone is using the CamLooper camera. Stop the phone camera to use these controls.

file.confirmBody: {{phone}} wants to loop this video on your camera. It replaces the video that is playing now.
file.failed: Couldn't loop the video from your phone.
file.expired: That request has already expired. Send the video from your phone again.
